case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: Outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; soil depth about 18 cm above the base, with drainage holes and raised feet.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Sand both faces and edges smooth.
Cut 58 cm front, 58 cm back, 3.4 cm offcut.
Place the 18 cm board flat for cutting.
Sand both faces and edges smooth.
Cut 58 cm base, two 14 cm ends, offcut.
Place the narrow board flat for cutting.
Sand both faces and edges smooth.
Cut two 18 cm feet and keep offcut.
Place the 58 cm base flat.
Drill five drainage holes through the base.
Stand front on base at front edge.
Stand back on base at back edge.
Fit first end between sides at start.
Fit second end between sides at end.
Drive 2 screws through the front into the first end
Drive 2 screws through the front into the second end
Drive 2 screws through the back into the first end
Drive 2 screws through the back into the second end
Drive 2 screws through the base into the front
Drive 2 screws through the base into the back
Drive 2 screws through the base into the first end
Drive 2 screws through the base into the second end
Place first foot under base near start.
Place second foot under base near end.
Drive 2 screws through the first foot into the base
Drive 2 screws through the second foot into the base
